+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML blocks in Windows stderr, preserving other bytes."""
+    output = []
+    last = 0

+    for header in _CLIXML_HEADER.finditer(stderr):

+        pos = header.end()
+        # PowerShell can emit more than one header before an XML element.
+        while True:

+                pos += 1
+            repeated_header = _CLIXML_HEADER.match(stderr, pos)

+
+        if not stderr.startswith(b'<Objs ', pos):
+            continue
+
+        end = stderr.find(b'</Objs>', pos)
+        if end == -1:
+            continue
+        end += len(b'</Objs>')
+
+        # Adjacent XML elements belong to the same CLIXML message.
+        while True:
+            next_pos = end
+            while next_pos < len(stderr) and stderr[next_pos] in b'\r\n':
+                next_pos += 1
+            if not stderr.startswith(b'<Objs ', next_pos):
+                break
+            next_end = stderr.find(b'</Objs>', next_pos)
+            if next_end == -1:
+                break
+            end = next_end + len(b'</Objs>')
+
+        try:
+            block = stderr[header.start():end]
+            try:
+                block = block.decode('utf-8').encode('utf-8')
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                block = block.decode('cp437').encode('utf-8')
+            replacement = _parse_clixml(block)
+        except (ET.ParseError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
+            continue
+
+        output.extend((stderr[last:header.start()], replacement))
+        last = end
+

+        return stderr
+    output.append(stderr[last:])
+    return b''.join(output)

+    (b'\r\nCLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1"><S S="Error">bare</S></Objs>tail', b'baretail'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1">\r\n<S S="Error">split</S>\r\n</Objs>end', b'splitend'),

+    (b'#< CLIXML\n<Objs Version="1.1"><S S="Error">split header</S></Objs>',
+     b'#< CLIXML\n<Objs Version="1.1"><S S="Error">split header</S></Objs>'),

+def test_replace_stderr_clixml(stderr, expected):
